statusVocabulary.established: A theorem, exact typed construction, or executable fixture is valid within its declared hypotheses. This need not pass a programme gate.
statusVocabulary.conditionally-constructed: The requested object exists after named coefficients, domains, controls, or backgrounds are supplied externally.
statusVocabulary.internally-exhausted: Every route using only present corpus inputs ends in a derivation, scoped no-go, or named external datum. More algebra on the same inputs is not frontier progress.
statusVocabulary.externally-open: A named new action, coefficient, domain, measurement, device calculation, or specialist input could change the status.
statusVocabulary.failed: A precisely delimited candidate class is ruled out. Failure is not silently generalized to the whole gate.

dependencyEdges.meaning: The folded defect supplies domains that A4 must quantize.
A physical renormalized stress operator presupposes a physical state space and domains.
The selected fermion spectrum must live in the admitted Hilbert space.
The current Standard-Model branch uses the selector to choose one chiral carrier.
The claimed physical response must be computed in the matched low-energy theory.
The spectral density needs a fixed renormalized operator.
A protected-sector programme test needs the actual defect and sectors.
A powered programme test needs a physical effect prediction.

edgeQualification: These edges are typed workflow dependencies for the present mechanism. They are not universal logical dependencies for every analogue experiment or alternative theory.

gates.name: defect origin, orientation, and charged reader
gates.survivingClaim: The charge-three Higgs sector alone has no physical codimension-one wall; adding one neutral Z2 order parameter plus a fold yields an exact infinite-cover kink and one even gapped charge-one reader mode.
failedCandidateClasses: charge-three scalar alone as a codimension-one wall source
gates.firstExternalDatum: A microscopic origin for the neutral eta field and fold/history orientation together with one globally compatible compact outer domain.
gates.reopenCondition: Reopen when a UV action derives eta or an equivalent interface, fixes the compact boundary conditions, and reproduces the BF parity/reader spectrum without importing orientation.
gates.forbiddenOverclaim: S_v1 by itself derives the defect, its orientation, or an exact finite-slab tanh spectrum.

gates.name: physical states, domains, BRST cohomology, and residues
gates.survivingClaim: One explicit bulk tree-level point has positive gauge, scalar, projector, wall, reader, and conventional fermion pole data; no negative physical residue has been found in the defined sectors.
gates.firstExternalDatum: A local Lorentz- and gauge-compatible fermionic fold/domain, or an explicitly chosen APS, vectorlike, full-wall, or Nambu alternative.
gates.reopenCondition: Reopen after one fermion-domain escape is fixed and the full boundary BRST complex, self-adjointness, lower bound, and pole residues are recomputed on that domain.
gates.forbiddenOverclaim: The candidate action is fully healthy, unitary, or has a completed physical Hilbert space merely because its bulk bosonic benchmark is positive.

gates.name: physical selector and phase reference
gates.survivingClaim: Symmetric endpoint-blind data cannot equivariantly select a non-fixed orientation; no declared CP, CPT, boundary normal, Z3, flavor, Majorana, Yukawa, or index datum canonically fixes the sterile scalar/pseudoscalar axis.
failedCandidateClasses: universal real selector from symmetric data
gates.firstExternalDatum: One physical R2 phase-reference datum together with a local exchange-odd portal that locks it to the charged chiral carrier.
gates.reopenCondition: Reopen only when a transforming measured field, boundary/history variable, Pfaffian orientation, or equivalent datum is inserted into a gauge-complete operator and shown to select the full carrier.
gates.forbiddenOverclaim: CP, residual Z3, anomaly cancellation, an oriented normal, or index three already chooses the physical selector or Majorana phase axis.

gates.name: three-generation chiral Standard-Model limit
gates.survivingClaim: The canonical completion CP1 carries a pulled-back O(3) line whose twisted Dirac operator has universal index three, but the minimal local same-six-dimensional-chirality parent is anomalous.
failedCandidateClasses: one same-chirality six-dimensional parent for each SM15 plus N, all twisted by O(3)
six-dimensional Dirac repair without a mirror-removal mechanism
gates.firstExternalDatum: An anomaly-free local or spectral real structure preserving the +3 kernel, removing independent mirrors, and supplying a bundle-invariant sterile pairing.
gates.reopenCondition: Reopen when the full higher-dimensional anomaly polynomial vanishes, localized/inflow anomalies are included, the self-adjoint CAR polarization is explicit, and the reduced spectrum has three complete generations with no independent mirror kernel.
gates.forbiddenOverclaim: The index-three bundle already derives three physical generations, or rank-nullity proves that every finite four-dimensional operator is incapable of a protected multiplicity.

gates.name: renormalized stress operator and probes
gates.survivingClaim: The classical Hilbert-stress ledger is conditional, and the traceless reader vertex and its pole/support threshold are independent of xi within the displayed scalar-improvement family.
failedCandidateClasses: scheme-independent full third matrix direction from the unfixed trace channel
gates.firstExternalDatum: A curved microscopic matching calculation or operational renormalization condition fixing xi and the common physical trace/traceless port map.
gates.reopenCondition: Reopen when a completed curved action and domain determine the stress counterterms, displacement contacts, Ward identities, xi at a stated scale, and calibrated probes.
gates.forbiddenOverclaim: Spin(2,3) predicts xi, the full third direction is scheme invariant, or the integrated cancellation proves every frequency-resolved third component vanishes.

gates.name: physical spectral response
gates.survivingClaim: A finite/free reader has a positive retarded differential spectrum with a CP-even holonomy threshold contrast; an interacting pole-plus-band analysis can include linewidth, disorder, calibration, and sector confusion.
failedCandidateClasses: static occupation covariance as an analytic continuation of the retarded response
unmatched third matrix direction as the primary observable
gates.firstExternalDatum: A microscopic interacting Hamiltonian and renormalized port operator predicting the sector-dependent pole, residue, linewidth, and band weight.
gates.reopenCondition: Reopen when the matched A4/A7 action produces a causal spectral density with uncertainties and a device-to-operator port map fixed before sector labels.
gates.forbiddenOverclaim: The finite Gaussian fixture is the physical Spin(2,3) response, its toy thresholds transfer to a device, or positivity alone identifies the mechanism.

gates.name: discriminating experiment
gates.survivingClaim: A preregisterable differential two-port pole-and-band protocol with calibration, disorder, confusion, power, and powered-null gates exists; current Aharonov-Casher hardware can test continuous holonomy sensitivity.
failedCandidateClasses: signed third matrix direction as an unqualified primary endpoint
gates.firstExternalDatum: A device-specific pre-unblinding prediction of pole shift, spectral residue, and both port matrix elements; protected-Z3 evidence is additionally required for the programme mechanism.
gates.reopenCondition: Reopen for execution when the microscopic device prediction passes the resolution/power gate; promote to a Spin(2,3)-programme test only after genuine protected-Z3 sector preparation and scaling are independently verified.
gates.forbiddenOverclaim: The protocol is laboratory-ready without a signal prediction, three continuous U1 settings are protected Z3 sectors, or an operational Aharonov-Casher pass establishes Spin(2,3).

independentGraphLane.survivingClaim: A scaled cycle selects a refinement-stable real first-harmonic plane; three independently addressed anisotropic edge controls generate full sp(4,R), hence conditional Spin0(2,3) response symmetry.
independentGraphLane.firstExternalDatum: An action-derived source of orientation/addressed anisotropy, or an experiment showing the ten-generator closure survives loss, disorder, and held-out perturbations.
independentGraphLane.reopenCondition: Reopen only for a new dynamical control mechanism, universality theorem beyond cycles, Lorentzian physical-state construction, or discriminating experiment.
independentGraphLane.forbiddenOverclaim: The graph construction derives Spin(2,3) as fundamental spacetime symmetry or obtains full closure from the unaddressed symmetric cycle.
